ambiguities: The structure on the far right matches the architectural style and is connected by a roofed breezeway, so it is treated as part of the subject property. The front triangular face on the upper level is white stucco with an awning, identifying it as a vertical gable wall rather than a roof plane; its visible sloped edges are rakes. Several horizontal tile bands on the walls are identified as decorative courses/ledges and excluded.
